name: speshul-skills
description: Original skills and plugins that make agent behavior more reliable, bounded, inspectable, and repeatable.

plugins.name: cleancoding
plugins.description: Evidence-backed engineering discipline: acceptance contracts, root-cause fixes, a hook-enforced verification gate, and the shared three-loop stop rule.

plugins.name: anti-loop
plugins.description: Keeps coding work scoped to the requested outcome and enforces the shared three-loop stop rule with a stateful PostToolUse hook.

plugins.name: anti-amnesia
plugins.description: Answers retrospective questions from the recorded session and closes work with the shared handoff receipt.

plugins.name: temporal-tasks
plugins.description: Estimates task difficulty and active-work budgets, then emits deterministic elapsed-time and repeated-call signals from lifecycle hooks.

plugins.name: graph-engineering
plugins.description: Select, design, compile, audit, diagnose, optimize, and evolve executable AI workflow graphs with typed state, bounded runtime semantics, and validation tooling.

plugins.name: video-to-particle-field
plugins.description: Turns video and images into live particle or ASCII fields with stable particle identity and scroll-driven scene transitions.

plugins.name: facebook-content-studio
plugins.description: Researches, plans, continuity-checks, packages, and approval-gates Facebook Page content with routing to Higgsfield media workflows and the companion Page publisher.

plugins.name: skill-authoring
plugins.description: Writes and audits agent skills and plugins to this repository's standards, with a deterministic validator for frontmatter, size, links, manifests, and shared contracts.

plugins.name: untrusted-content
plugins.description: Handles web pages, files, tool output, and inter-agent messages as data rather than instructions, with injection triage and a bounded escalation path.

plugins.name: marketing-hub
plugins.description: An evidence-to-artifact marketing operating system: one orchestrator and forty-three specialist skills organized by the decision they answer, sharing a truth file, claim ledger, and deliverable contracts.
